plan.title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Dilemma
plan.logline: A lighthouse keeper must choose between saving a ship's last survivor or turning off the lamp that guides ships home.
plan.ending: The survivor safely ashore, the keeper facing the cost of her decision.
world_rules: The lighthouse is the only source of light in the area.
The keeper must decide whether to turn off the lamp or not.
The ship's last survivor is the only person who can be saved.
The keeper can only turn off the lamp once.
The lamp is crucial for guiding ships home and ensuring safety.

characters.name: Lighthouse Keeper
characters.appearance: A middle-aged man with a rugged face and a kind demeanor
characters.goal: To save the last survivor of the ship that has run aground
initial_knowledge: The ship is the only source of light for the area
The keeper has the ability to turn off the lamp

characters.name: Last Survivor
characters.appearance: A young woman in distress, possibly from a shipwreck
characters.goal: To be rescued by the lighthouse keeper
initial_knowledge: She is the last person on the ship
She needs the light to be saved

locations.name: Lighthouse

locations.description: The source of light for the area, but also the source of the problem

episodes.title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Dilemma

script.screenplay:
The Lighthouse Keeper's Dilemma: The Keeper Receives the Message

[1, 2, 3, 4]

**Shot 1:** [Lighthouse, Lighthouse Keeper, Last Survivor]

**Action:** The Keeper receives a message from the ship. She must decide whether to turn off the lamp or not.

**Dialogue/Narration:**

**Keeper:** I have the ability to turn off the lamp. What do I do?

**Last Survivor:** Please, I need the light to be saved.

**Keeper:** I will turn off the lamp. I will save you.

**Shot 2:** [Lighthouse, Lighthouse Keeper, Ship]

**Action:** The Keeper turns off the lamp. She rescues the last survivor.

**Dialogue/Narration:**

**Keeper:** The lamp is crucial for guiding ships home and ensuring safety.

**Last Survivor:** Thank you, I will be safe now.
